title: Isolation of deletion alleles of C. elegans by G4-DNA induced mutagenesis
protocol: Clone out 96 single dog-1 animals onto 96 6 cm petridishes.
Grow plates until starvation.
Rinse off half the plate (optional).
Freeze rinsed-off worms as backup.
Rinse off half of the worms in M9 buffer.
Transfer rinsed worms to 96 well PCR plates in duplicate.
Remove supernatant from PCR plates.
Add 50 μL lysis buffer to worm pellet.
Lyse worm pellets at 60°C for 60 minutes.
Inactivate proteinase K at 95°C for 30 minutes.
Perform nested PCRs on 1 μL of the lysis mix in a total volume of 10 μL.
Include control PCR reactions with lysed wild type (N2) worms and blank sample.
Use PCR conditions: 1x buffer, 0.5 mM dNTPs, 0.5 μM each primer, 0.025 U ml-1 Taq polymerase.
Run PCR program at 95°C for 1 minute followed by 35 cycles of 95°C for 20 seconds, 58°C for 40 seconds, and 72°C for 1 minute; then 72°C for 3 minutes.
Transfer 0.2 μL mix from the first PCR to the second PCR as template.
Load 5 μL of the second PCR onto a 1% agarose gel.
Search for duplicates that have a band of identical size to identify a positive population.
Chunk the plate corresponding to the positive population into 12 pieces onto fresh 6 cm plates.
Include lysis DNA from the previous, positive round as a positive control.
Grow till starvation and repeat the procedure from step 3 to step 7.
If one or more plates result in a deletion product of identical size to the original positive sample, transfer ~10 worms to 48 new 6 cm plates.
Grow till starvation and repeat steps 3 to 7.
Return to the plate out of 48 that contains the positive population and clone out 48 single worms from this plate on fresh plates.
Grow till starvation and repeat steps 4 to 8.
Alternatively, grow for a few days and then pick the mother into 10 μL lysis buffer.
Perform PCRs on this sample.
Perform nested PCR on approximately 15 individual animals from the positive population.
Verify that all individuals are positive for the deletion allele.
Design primers within the deleted segment to confirm loss of DNA in these animals.
Clone out more than six animals from the positive population if not all are homozygous.
Perform nested PCR on twelve F1 progeny animals for each cloned animal.
Use the remaining 5 μL from the PCR reaction for sequencing the deletion.
Cross the new strain several times back to N2 to remove dog-1(gk10) and possible secondary mutations.
